programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5 (历史不通的祖父秀 Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how! (李建丁师,坚强的老师丁,无疑是武术的士,但他厨艺技巧也令人印象深刻!丁师与精明的食品熟练者坦尤宁合作建立了士丁厨房.每集都带着观众去寻找他们最喜欢的食材,丁师亲自做各种特色的菜,和甜点,提供怀旧的堪敦式美食!如何以负担得起的价格做真实的传统烤?如何控制鱼时的热量和时间?秋冬,许多人喜欢香水米,特别是脆的米皮.但你有没有见过士丁的米米两侧都显示了米米的米技巧吗?看看看!)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.desc: Set during the Chuigong era of the Wu ZhouTang Dynasty, the story follows Di Renjie as he grows disillusioned with the political intrigues of Empress Wu Zetians imperial court. Leaving the capital to inspect the southern Jiangnan region, he is drawn into a series of five strange, seemingly supernatural cases (故事发生在武王朝的楚时代,迪伦杰因王妃武泽蒂安帝国宫廷的政治阴谋而感到失望.离开首都去检查江南南部地区,他被卷入了五起奇怪,看似超自然的案件.)

programme.desc: In this 10-episode journey across South America, Christy explores three iconic destinationsPeru, Bolivia, and Brazilcombining extreme adrenaline challenges, local culture, and high-energy sightseeing (在这个10集的南美洲旅程中,Christy探索了三个标志性目的地秘鲁,玻利维亚和巴西,)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today ((News At 18:30 Global View 豆瓣电影))
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30. (每天下午6点30分,Jade Channel报道了重要的当地,跨海峡和国际新闻.)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.title: Network News
programme.desc: Network News is a 30min news, news about china and the world.

programme.title: Gao Xing De Suan Tian Ku La
programme.desc: Set in a rapidly changing Beijing, optimistic small-town dreamer Chang Gao Xing meets local girl Li Sasa. Despite their contrasting backgrounds, the two bond as they face career failures, financial struggles, and personal heartbreak togetherultimately finding love, maturity, and a place to call home.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: New Taiwan Is Online
programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Mommy Says
programme.desc: A warm and relatable lifestyle talk show that explores the daily dynamics between mothers, daughters-in-law, and modern families. Through real stories, lighthearted conversations, and practical tips on relationships, parenting, and home life, the program highlights touching and humorous moments that help viewers navigate family harmony with ease.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong ((血溅塘西))
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun. (警官和三方领袖团结起来取数十亿美元的. 作为一个律师加入他的朋友在ICAC调查他们的勾结和打击腐败,正义人和邪恶之间的战斗刚刚开始.)

programme.title: One More Chance (另一个机会)
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams. (博成的Fai被他的前女朋友委托照顾他们的自闭症儿子.从一个混乱的父亲-儿子关系开始,逐渐变成了相互赎回的旅程,帮助他重新发现自己.)

programme.title: Customs Frontline ((海关战线))
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home. (香港海关官员发现在国际冲突相关的货运船上非法武器.)

programme.title: Tristar ((福禄寿训练学院))
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Lius investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him? (夫人探查她与妓女圈的联系.夫人找到了合法的工作,帮助她与地下世界谈判.此同时,夫人的调查引发了误解 - - 他能否打击帮派?夫人将如何管理他的情绪,当夫人爱上他?)

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience ((沈默杀机))
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail. (由于Adrian大律师的尖锐疏忽,他的无辜当事人被判犯有谋杀罪并被判处17年监禁。 几年后,他有机会上诉并释放他的当事人,但为了纠正他的错误,他必须同香港最有权势的家庭之一斗争,以伸张正义。)

programme.title: Seoul Raiders ((韩城攻略))
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them. (日本国家安全局的一个特工和一个熟练的小偷一起找到了一张用来伪造美元的牌照。 但是,一位美国大使馆代表却出现并偷走了车牌,带着车牌逃往韩国。)

programme.title: Stand Up Story (站起来故事)
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter! (Mancer知道父亲Wah年轻时在智力上受到挑战,在母亲离开后必须照顾他。 当Mancer发现并找到立体喜剧中的安慰时,他了解到困难提供了最好的喜剧材料 — — 从他在学校的嘲弄经历到大灾难,痛苦会激起欢笑!)

programme.title: Confinement (封锁)
programme.desc: Si Ling, a pregnant painter, moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. As she begins her one-month confinement after giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby (怀孕的画家Si Ling,怀孕的画家,在获奖后搬进梦中家庭,并雇用了一名分娩保姆。 当她开始分娩后一个月的分娩时,家里开始发生难以解释的事件,威胁她和她的婴儿。)

programme.title: No One Like Me ((乱马½))
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate. (帝国天文学家第三位门徒杨建万曾是金童。 然而,自徐琦安出生以来,他的荣耀已消逝。 他坚持不懈的追求不能违抗无情的真理:一切已早料而终。 Yang自倒台以来,却自欺欺人,自命不凡,拒绝顺从命运。)

programme.title: The Last Dance ((最后的舞动))
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen. (在这场大流行病引发的经济衰退中,负债累累的婚礼策划者沈成在他向丧葬计划者过渡的过程中找到了一条生命线。 他的非常规方法导致出乎意料的成功,他对他的职业生涯和生活的态度在受到尊敬的温大师的启发后发生了转变。)

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell ((扫毒3：人在天涯))
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchats drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust (香港警察Billy在Suchats贩毒集团卧底工作,而另一个卧底警察联翼成功地赢得了他们对一起事件的信任,并在三者之间建立起了兄弟关系。 当警察查封了黑帮时,Suchat和Billy逃到金三角,在信任圈内得到关于背叛的举报。)

programme.title: Rob N Roll ((临时劫案))
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line! (一位无情的土匪,天安,策划了一场激烈而迅速的武装抢劫。 当他遇到同时策划抢劫的惠惠和水惠时,他们决定为抢劫联合起来。 然而,他们的临时和戏剧性抢劫引发了一场与警方的激烈争斗,使他们的生命垂危在线上!)

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life ((浅浅岁月))
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime. (桑比娜对安德鲁的深厚爱情在他的恋爱破坏了他们的婚姻后,导致她的心碎.多年后,当安德鲁被诊断患有癌症时,桑比娜选择回来照顾她的前丈夫,尽管过去的痛苦.随着旧情绪的复苏,她仍然相信真正的爱情只会在一生中出现一次.)

programme.title: Ride On ((怪物猎人物语 RIDE ON))
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, Red Hare may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile. (卢老爷是一个被洗劫的特技演员,他训练他心爱的红兔马成为特技马。 但是,由于他的债务,红兔可能被债务国夺走。 卢老爷别无选择,只能从他离家出走的女儿那里寻求帮助,这一事件最终成为他们和解的良机。)

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant (帕凡为婴儿)
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope. (在一个保守的社会中,一个从未关闭的婴儿孵化场引发激烈的道德争议和公众反弹。 尽管批评和压力越来越大,莱苏、法蒂玛、卡姆杰和努鲁仍然坚定地履行保护绝望母亲的使命,没有别的地方可去,同时为被遗弃的新生儿提供脆弱的生活和希望机会。)

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clans fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star ((星际钝胎))
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other. (一个漂亮但无知的女人被外星人绑架,但没有人相信她的近距离遇见. 计划自杀以证明自己,她遇到了一个失败的侦探,他也计划自杀. 他们在发现彼此后改变了他们的想法,开始遇到奇怪的冒险,然后爱上彼此.)

programme.title: The Sword of Swords ((剑来))
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword. (剑师在死前把剑交给他的门徒林.然而,林很快发现另一个门徒也看到剑,并阴谋把剑从林那里夺走,摧毁他的家人,并使他盲目.最后,林为报复战斗,并发誓要夺回剑.)

programme.title: The Love Eterne ((七世夫妻之梁山伯与祝英台))
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave. (泰伪装为男孩去上学,爱上了同学博.发现她真实身份后,博提出婚约,才知道泰已与另一个男人交婚.被迫分离,博绝望地去世.被消息摧毁,博在他的坟墓上自杀.)

programme.title: The Pirate ((风流海盗))
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process. (海盗张保猜在成功袭击外国商船后发现船上漏水。 他上岸获取材料以修补船舶,但遇到腐败的清军官员压迫贫穷农民。 一位心怀善良的人决定帮助农民,并赢得了在这一过程中的伟大海盗声誉。)

programme.title: The Female Prince ((这个王妃有点萌))
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan (小巧继母在她未婚夫龙龙拒绝放弃婚约并把他送进监狱时,陷害她未婚夫龙龙,小萧为了救他,伪装成龙龙,参加皇室考试,排第一。小萧受皇帝的压迫,将公主嫁给他。当小萧在新婚之夜洗干净时,她劝公主按照计划行事。)

programme.title: King Gambler ((千王之王重出江湖))
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976. (这部电影其实是赌博电影狂欢的热门先锋,最终席卷亚洲电影院。 在这部电影中,卡斯特哈普与卡斯特哈普的对决更激烈的功夫,在一场拳击和拳击的战斗中成为赌场的国王。 双刺和三重十字架在复杂和想象力方面增加了复杂性和三倍,直到作为非同寻常的票房风险开始成为1976年的前十大打击。)

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West ((西游记))
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing. (故事是从同名的经典中国小说中改编的.故事讲述了唐山宗僧侣前往西方寻找佛教的苏格拉.在路上,他遇到了子,猪和沙武.)

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun ((太阳的后裔))
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world. (世盛被一个老的幼虫收养,长大后拥有超强的超能力。 有一天,他意外地发现了自己作为太阳神的儿子的身份,并了解到在日食期间他的力量将丧失。 当邪恶的灵魂出现并造成破坏时,史胜必须击败他,以拯救世界。)

programme.title: Empress Wu ((唐朝禁宫秘史))
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor. (泽天是唐皇帝14岁的美丽和才华横溢的女神.她在唐皇帝去世后成为修道女,但与新皇帝唐高宗生了两个儿子.皇帝女士要求与她合作,反对夫人,但被设置并推翻了王位,他也杀了她的两个儿子.)

programme.title: The Champion ((冠军))
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back. (在多年的监狱里,卢胡回国后发现自己是由他无情的哥哥皮奥所建立的,他接管了家族煤矿生意,监禁了自己的妹妹。 胡图人把豹子抓了下来,救了他的妹妹,但是他们的煤矿落入了日本黑帮的手中,胡图人和他姐姐必须战斗起来,才能得到它。)

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake ((寒煙翠))
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget. (一位年轻的女孩陈是被离婚的父母送走的。 在长斯农场上,她遇到了他们的两个儿子、最小的女儿和一个年轻的艺术家,并且和他们度过了她永远不会忘记的夏天。)

programme.title: Crippled Avengers ((残缺))
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his sons arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin. (楚双在儿子被砍掉胳膊后发疯,他无缘无故伤害了四人,造成他们各种残疾。 四名残疾人组成了一个乐队,从大师那里学习功夫,以便报复楚双。)

programme.title: Tales of Larceny ((牛鬼蛇神))
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step. (连接了所有老板,僧侣,乞和盗窃者的事,)

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar ((绝不低头))
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kams empire. (20世纪20年代上海时,一个乡村女孩前往大城市寻找她的父亲,并会见了她童年时的朋友贾瓜尔(Jaguar ), 他为暴徒老大卡姆工作。 在暴徒控制的世界中,这是对作为 " 捷豹 " 和Ace枪手Ko Tang的盟友的所有人生存的考验,以接管卡姆斯帝国。)

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles ((故都春梦))
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves. (范家舒是一位心地善良的学生,他与心地善良的爱歌歌手沈相爱,但并非只有他有对沈的目光,将军们的亲信也决心将歌唱者作为礼物送给上司。 范恩及时得到一个出乎意料的人的帮助,以拯救他所爱的女人。)

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer ((茅山僵尸拳))
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good. (最早的功夫喜剧之一,就是关于一个骗子的故事,他利用功夫欺骗村民赚钱,假装被鬼魂附身。 当他们受到强盗的威胁时,他必须用同样的技能为善。)

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Junior lawyer, Ravindra, agrees to help a business magnate clear her fathers name of murder, but his true colors are revealed as more bodies appear.

Cyril heads to Polynesia to catch a legendary fish known to the locals as the Uruati, but he isnt prepared for the incredible number of sharks lurking below the waters. (冒险者Cyril Chauquet(Cyril Chauquet)寻找世界上最巨大和危险的水下生物。 西里尔前往波利尼西亚捕捉当地人称为Uruati(Uruati)的传奇鱼类,但他并不准备在水下潜伏的鲨鱼数量惊人。)

programme.title: After The Wildfires

programme.title: 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 왔다! 내 손주
programme.desc: 해외에 거주하고 있어 자주 보지 못하는 손자, 손녀들과 할머니, 할아버지가 만나 보내는 며칠의 시간. 뭉클한 감동이 깃든 만남부터 그들에게 주어진 짧은 기간 일어나는 일들 속에 따듯한 가족애를 담아내는 프로그램

programme.title: 아파트

programme.title: 아파트

programme.title: 냉장고를 부탁해 since 2014

programme.title: 궁금한 이야기 Y
programme.desc: 실제로 일어난 사건 중 시청자들이 가장 궁금한 화제와 인물을 추적하여 궁금한 이야기의 왜WHY를 보여주는 프로그램이다.

programme.title: 생방송 투데이
programme.desc: 뉴스에서 트렌드, 이벤트, 여가 생활정보에 이르기까지 시청자들이 궁금해 하는 모든 것을 알차고 재미있고 정확하게 전달하는 종합 정보 와이드 프로그램

programme.title: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 그날 이야기
programme.desc: 눈길을 사로잡는 그 날, 그 사건으로부터 한 사람의 소시민으로서 내가 느낀 바를, 온전히 나의 시점에서 주관적으로 전달한다. 너 에게 꼭 들려주고 싶어! 친구, 배우자, 동료... 세 명의 이야기꾼이 스스로 공부하며 느낀 바를 각자의 이야기 친구가장 가까운 지인에게, 가장 일상적인 공간에서 1:1 로 전달한다.

programme.title: TV 유치원
programme.desc: 아이들은 놀면서 자라고, 놀면서 배운다! 재미있고 자유롭게 놀 수 있는 공간! 신나는 놀이판이 벌여진다! 교육적 내용과 다양한 놀이로 아이들의 오감을 키우는 어린이 체험형 프로그램

programme.title: 누가 누가 잘하나

programme.title: 2TV 생생정보

programme.title: 신상출시 편스토랑

programme.title: 동물의 왕국

programme.desc: 캐스팅 0순위 천만배우이자 자타공인 최고의 스캔들 메이커 박강. 화려한 싱글 라이프를 만끽하고 있지만, 정작 크리스마스이브에 끌어안을 것이라고는 연말 시상식 트로피뿐. 유일한 친구이자 뒤처리 전문 매니저 조윤을 붙잡아 거하게 한잔하고 택시를 잡아탄다. 다음날 아침, 낯선 집에서 깨어난 박강에게 생전 처음 보는 꼬맹이 둘이 안겨오고, 성공을 위해 이별했던 첫사랑 수현이 잔소리를 폭격하며 등짝 스매싱을 날리는 것이 아닌가? 게다가 매니저 조윤이 천만배우가 되어 그가 있어야 할 톱스타의 자리를 꿰차고 있는데 이게 무슨 황당한 시추에이션?! 180도 뒤집어진 인생에 속이 뒤집어지는 박강은 불현듯, 지난밤 택시 기사가 무심코 건넨 한마디가 떠오르는데 quot만약에 선택을 바꿀 기회가 생긴다면, 어떻게 하시겠어요?quot

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.
